interface.signature: def maxScoreWords(self, words: List[str], letters: List[str], score: List[int]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of words must be between 1 and 14.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(word) <= 15 for word in words)
preconditions.description: Each word must have a length between 1 and 15.
The number of letters must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: len(score) == 26 and all(0 <= s <= 10 for s in score)
preconditions.description: The score list must have exactly 26 elements, each between 0 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(word.islower() and all(c.islower() for c in word) for word in words) and all(c.islower() for c in letters)
preconditions.description: All words and letters must consist of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum score of any valid set of words formed by the given letters.
